Row by row: Personal services 114,598 = 38,199 + 38,200 + 38,199; Contractual 600,247 = 559,195 + 3,890 + 4,238 + 32,924; Utilities 15,923 = 6,282 + 9,641; Repairs 27,600 = 19,745 + 1,520 + 5,448 + 887; Other supplies statement 85,277 vs schedules 57,847 + 12,343 + 13,449 + 1,640 = 85,279 (report rounding, 2).
